english.title: Engage in conduct in preparation for terrorist acts - Terrorism
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) with the intention of

(A)_[committing]_
(B)_[assisting another to commit]_

acts of terrorism engaged in conduct in preparation for giving effect to your intention
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5 of the Terrorism Act 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
with the intention of committing/assisting another to commit acts of terrorism
engaged in conduct in preparation for giving effect to your intention

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 5(1) provides that it is irrelevant whether the intention and preparations relate to one or more particular acts of terrorism, acts of terrorism of a particular description or acts of terrorism generally.
(ii) For the liability of company directors etc. see section 18 of the Act.
(iii) Proceedings for this offence require the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions, section 19 of the Act.
(iv) See also Home Office Circular 8/2006, including explanations about this section.

other.powersofarrest:
For terrorist offences primarily consider: Arrest without warrant - terrorism
Also applicable: Arrest without warrant
other.penalty:
Imprisonment for life.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None This offence is also specified as a serious terrorism offence (Part 1 of Schedule 17A to the Sentencing Act 2020) and subject to serious terrorism sentences of imprisonment or extended sentences; see note (v) in section 306 for details.
